strings.msg_no_backend:
No system-wide WinGet was found.

winstall is a frontend and needs the Windows Package Manager to work.

Press Yes to open the official download page (App Installer), install it, then restart winstall.
strings.status_no_backend: WinGet not found. Install App Installer, then restart winstall.
strings.check_missing: WinGet is not installed, updates cannot be checked.
strings.msg_nothing:
Nothing checked.

Check boxes:
• updatable — update (↑)
• fresh — uninstall (×)
• new from search — install (+).

Continue?
strings.msg_reinstall:
{0}: winget reports that the installer technology
differs from the installed version, so a direct
update is impossible.

Remove the package and install the new version?
strings.msg_upd_all_q:
Update all {0} package(s)?

Same as `winget upgrade --all --silent`.
strings.msg_about:
winstall — a simple MInstall-style winget manager.
.NET Framework 4.8 WinForms, for Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC 21H2.

↑ update, × uninstall, + install.
strings.msg_auto_on:
Enabled, no admin rights needed:
• autostart at logon (HKCU Run key),
• check on wake (the \winstall\winstall-wake task).

winstall will quietly check for updates and show a notification with the count.
strings.msg_auto_off: Disabled: autostart and the wake task were removed.
